 The Honourable Sri Justice J.Sreenivas Rao

Order:

entities.text: Chitukula Srisailam, vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed seeking the following relief:
" ...to issue a writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of mandamus, declaring the inaction of the respondents in initiating proceedings under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Act No.30 of 2013) and in paying compensation to the petitioners, in relation to their land, and extent of Ac.3.00 gts in Sy.No.432 of Kandi Village, Sangareddy District, which was taken for the purpose of establishment of College of Agricultural Engineering - Sangareddy, as illegal,
arbitrary, violative of Articles 14, 21 and 300-A of the Constitution of India, as also contrary to the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and consequently direct the respondents to initiate land acquisition proceedings under Act No.30 of 2013 and pay appropriate compensation, along with all statutory benefits, for the petitioners'
land and pass..."
2. When the matter is taken up for consideration on 06.02.2025, there is no representation on behalf of petitioners.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: To give one opportunity, the matter is posted to 07.02.2025 under the caption 'for dismissal'.
Inspite of the matter being listed under the caption 'for dismissal', today also there is no representation on behalf of petitioners either in physical mode or virtual mode.
3. On 06.02.2025, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition submitted that the subject land to an extent of Ac.3.00 gts. was assigned in favour of Ch.Peda Sailoo, S/o Ramaiah.
The then Tahsildar, Sanga Reddy Mandal had issued show cause notice, dated 15.05.1997 to the original assignee on the ground that he has violated the assignment of patta conditions.
Thereafter, the subject land along with other lands was allotted for establishing the College of Agricultural Engineering, Sanga Reddy.

Hence, the petitioners are not entitled to seek payment of compensation as per the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 on the ground that their lands were already resumed after following the due procedure as contemplated under the provisions of the Telangana (A.P.)
Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfers) Act, 1977.
